script:
for _, name in ipairs({'SkillPanel','RelicPanel'}) do
 local panel = _EntityService:GetEntityByPath('/ui/TitleGroup/' .. name)
 local area = panel:GetChildByName('ScrollArea').UITransformComponent
 assert(area.RectSize.x == 1420 and area.RectSize.y == 670, 'Viewport size')
 local scale = area.Scale.x
 assert(math.abs(area.anchoredPosition.y - (45 * scale + 58.5 * (1-scale))) < .02, 'List center')
 local list = panel:GetChildByName('ScrollArea'):GetChildByName('List')
 local stem = name == 'SkillPanel' and 'SkillSlot_' or 'RelicSlot_'
 local verified = 0
 for i = 0, 150 do
  local slot = list:GetChildByName(stem .. tostring(i))
  if isvalid(slot) then
   local icon = slot:GetChildByName('Icon').UITransformComponent
   local dimEntity = slot:GetChildByName('Dim')
   assert(icon.RectSize.x == 118 and icon.anchoredPosition.y == 34, 'Icon safe bounds')
   if isvalid(dimEntity) then
    local dim = dimEntity.UITransformComponent
    assert(dim.RectSize.x == 122 and dim.RectSize.y == 126 and dim.anchoredPosition.y == 34, 'Dim safe bounds')
   end
   verified = verified + 1
  end
 end
 assert(verified > 0, 'No slots')
 log('[PanelRefineQA] list=' .. name .. ' shiftedDown=40 verifiedSlots=' .. tostring(verified))
end

assert(_SkillUI._gradeFilter == 1, 'Grade selection')
for i, b in ipairs({_SkillUI.btnGradeAll,_SkillUI.btnGradeNormal,_SkillUI.btnGradeMagic,_SkillUI.btnGradeRare}) do
 local selected = i == 2
 assert(b.Entity:GetChildByName('SelectionMark').Enable == selected, 'Grade check')
 local expected = selected and '0cfbd6e3aa6845abb4a42659d01b6078' or 'd64558d3613a4e9bbe94fb4223e9d88d'
 assert(b.Entity.SpriteGUIRendererComponent.ImageRUID.DataId == expected, 'Grade color')
end
assert(_SkillUI.gradeFilterBtn.Entity.SpriteGUIRendererComponent.Color.r > .99, 'Active tint')
assert(not string.find(_SkillUI:GetFilterText(_SkillUI.gradeFilterBtn.Entity).Text,'UI_TITLE'), 'Untranslated grade')
log('[PanelRefineQA] gradeSelection=true label=' .. _SkillUI:GetFilterText(_SkillUI.gradeFilterBtn.Entity).Text)

assert(_SkillUI._characterFilter == 1, 'Character selection')
for i,b in ipairs({_SkillUI.btnCharAll,_SkillUI.btnCharArcana,_SkillUI.btnCharSylph,_SkillUI.btnCharReion,_SkillUI.btnCharShade,_SkillUI.btnCharRin}) do
 assert(b.Entity:GetChildByName('SelectionMark').Enable == (i == 3), 'Character check')
end
assert(not string.find(_SkillUI:GetFilterText(_SkillUI.characterFilterBtn.Entity).Text,'UI_TITLE'), 'Untranslated character')
log('[PanelRefineQA] characterSelection=true label=' .. _SkillUI:GetFilterText(_SkillUI.characterFilterBtn.Entity).Text)

assert(_SkillUI._upgradableOnly and _SkillUI.btnUpgOnly.Entity:GetChildByName('SelectionMark').Enable, 'Upgrade selection')
assert(not _SkillUI.btnUpgAll.Entity:GetChildByName('SelectionMark').Enable, 'Wrong upgrade check')

local ui = _SkillUpgradeUI
assert(ui.popupGroup.Enable,'Popup did not open')
local panel = ui.popupGroup:GetChildByName('Panel')
assert(panel.UITransformComponent.RectSize.y == 960,'Popup bounds')
assert(panel:GetChildByName('Bg').SpriteGUIRendererComponent.ImageRUID.DataId == 'c1cc4d2d92104fbdbd53971477fa4364','Popup art')
assert(panel:GetChildByName('BtnClose').SpriteGUIRendererComponent.ImageRUID.DataId == '84bf090442a841899f5274ad5f7725dd','Square close')
ui:SetUpgradeEnabled(false)
assert(ui.btnUpgrade.Entity.SpriteGUIRendererComponent.ImageRUID.DataId == '6a34f87232c649cfaa6d770aae45e293','Gray disabled')
assert(not ui.btnUpgrade.Enable,'Disabled interaction')

local ui = _RelicUpgradeUI
assert(ui.popupGroup.Enable,'Popup did not open')
local panel = ui.popupGroup:GetChildByName('Panel')
assert(panel.UITransformComponent.RectSize.y == 960,'Popup bounds')
assert(panel:GetChildByName('Bg').SpriteGUIRendererComponent.ImageRUID.DataId == 'c1cc4d2d92104fbdbd53971477fa4364','Popup art')
assert(panel:GetChildByName('BtnClose').SpriteGUIRendererComponent.ImageRUID.DataId == '84bf090442a841899f5274ad5f7725dd','Square close')
ui:SetUpgradeEnabled(false)
assert(ui.btnUpgrade.Entity.SpriteGUIRendererComponent.ImageRUID.DataId == '6a34f87232c649cfaa6d770aae45e293','Gray disabled')
assert(not ui.btnUpgrade.Enable,'Disabled interaction')

local seen = {}
for i=0,_SkillInventory.skillCount-1 do
 local grade = _SkillInventory:GetSkillGrade(i)
 if not seen[grade] then
  _SkillUpgradeUI:OpenForSkill(i)
  assert(_SkillUpgradeUI.bgSprite.ImageRUID.DataId == 'c1cc4d2d92104fbdbd53971477fa4364','Grade replaced popup art')
  seen[grade] = true
 end
end
_SkillUpgradeUI:Close()
assert(seen[1] and seen[2] and seen[3],'Missing grade coverage')
log('[PanelRefineQA] allThreeSkillGrades=true')

local root = _EntityService:GetEntityByPath('/ui/TitleGroup').UITransformComponent
local original = root.RectSize
local cases = {Vector2(1920,1080), Vector2(2048,960), Vector2(2560,1080), Vector2(1440,1080)}
local frame = _EntityService:GetEntityByPath('/ui/TitleGroup/SkillPanel/Frame').UITransformComponent
local content = _EntityService:GetEntityByPath('/ui/TitleGroup/SkillPanel/ContentSurface').UITransformComponent
for _, size in ipairs(cases) do
 root.RectSize = size
 _MobileScreenFitLogic:FitLobbyPanelArt()
 local expected = math.min(1, (root.RectSize.x - 40)/1880, (root.RectSize.y - 170)/903)
 assert(math.abs(frame.Scale.x - expected) < 0.001 and math.abs(content.Scale.x - expected) < 0.001, 'Panel containment scale failed')
 local x = frame.anchoredPosition.x
 _MobileScreenFitLogic:FitLobbyPanelArt()
 assert(math.abs(frame.anchoredPosition.x - x) < 0.001, 'Repeated fitting grew UI')
 log('[LobbyPanelsQA] contain=' .. tostring(size.x) .. 'x' .. tostring(size.y) .. ' scale=' .. tostring(expected) .. ' stable=true')
end
root.RectSize = original
_MobileScreenFitLogic.DebugForceMobile = true
_MobileScreenFitLogic:FitTabBar()
_MobileScreenFitLogic:FitLobbyPanelArt()
for _, p in ipairs(_MobileScreenFitLogic:GetLobbyPanelPaths()) do
 local panel = _EntityService:GetEntityByPath(p)
 local bg = panel:GetChildByName('Bg').UITransformComponent
 local m = _MobileScreenFitLogic:MeasureScreenLoose(panel.UITransformComponent)
 assert(m ~= nil, 'Background screen measure failed')
 assert(bg.anchoredPosition.x - bg.RectSize.x/2 <= m.x0 and bg.anchoredPosition.x + bg.RectSize.x/2 >= m.x1, 'Horizontal background gap')
 assert(bg.anchoredPosition.y - bg.RectSize.y/2 <= m.y0 and bg.anchoredPosition.y + bg.RectSize.y/2 >= m.y1, 'Vertical background gap')
end
_MobileScreenFitLogic.DebugForceMobile = false
log('[LobbyPanelsQA] measuredBackgroundCoverage=true mobileDebug=false')
